plugins.name: productivity
plugins.description: Anthropic's productivity plugin (tasks, memory, daily updates) without bundled MCP servers: it uses the connectors you already have.

plugins.name: kitty-image
plugins.description: hood's kitty-image plugin (show PNG and SVG images inline in kitty-graphics terminals) without the prompt.compose hook that organization security defaults skip.

plugins.name: md-show
plugins.description: Show a Markdown file as a readable HTML page, with Mermaid diagrams, in a terminal-browser split next to the terminal.

plugins.name: intellij
plugins.description: Keeps the .idea files IntelliJ rewrites on its own out of Claude's commits, and notifies you when IntelliJ waits for you to approve a run configuration.
